reason.zh-Hans: 妖物攻势难当，归元之力正重塑残躯，宜暂避其锋
reason.zh-Hant: 妖物攻勢難當，歸元之力正重塑殘軀，宜暫避其鋒
reason.en-US: The monster's assault is too fierce to withstand; the power of Origin Return is reshaping your broken body—better to avoid its edge for now.

reason.zh-Hans: 此番遭逢凶险，经脉受创、灵力涣散，需静养调息
reason.zh-Hant: 此番遭逢兇險，經脈受創、靈力渙散，需靜養調息
reason.en-US: This dangerous encounter has damaged your meridians and scattered your spirit power. Rest quietly and regulate your breath.

reason.zh-Hans: 荒野杀机四伏，待神魂归定、肉身复原后再行历练
reason.zh-Hant: 荒野殺機四伏，待神魂歸定、肉身復原後再行歷練
reason.en-US: The wilderness is fraught with deadly peril. Continue your training after your soul is settled and your body is restored.

reason.zh-Hans: 秘境群敌环伺，归元之力正修复伤势，整备后再入
reason.zh-Hant: 秘境群敵環伺，歸元之力正修復傷勢，整備後再入
reason.en-US: Foes press in from all sides in the Secret Realm; the power of Origin Return is mending your wounds—regroup before entering again.

reason.zh-Hans: 久战之下灵力枯竭、经脉受损，宜暂退调息
reason.zh-Hant: 久戰之下靈力枯竭、經脈受損，宜暫退調息
reason.en-US: After a prolonged battle, Spirit Energy is depleted and the meridians are damaged. Retreat and recuperate for now.

reason.zh-Hans: 此行未竟，待肉身复原、气息平稳后可再探秘境
reason.zh-Hant: 此行未竟，待肉身復原、氣息平穩後可再探秘境
reason.en-US: This journey remains unfinished. Once your body has recovered and your aura has steadied, you may explore the secret realm again.

reason.zh-Hans: 强敌威势远胜寻常，归元之力正重塑残躯
reason.zh-Hant: 強敵威勢遠勝尋常，歸元之力正重塑殘軀
reason.en-US: This formidable enemy far surpasses the ordinary; restorative origin power is rebuilding the shattered body.

reason.zh-Hans: 重创之下神魂震荡、经脉俱损，需潜心调息
reason.zh-Hant: 重創之下神魂震盪、經脈俱損，需潛心調息
reason.en-US: A grave blow has shaken the soul and damaged all meridians; careful meditation is needed to recover.

reason.zh-Hans: 此敌不可轻犯，待修为整备、洞悉其法后再战
reason.zh-Hant: 此敵不可輕犯，待修為整備、洞悉其法後再戰
reason.en-US: This foe must not be challenged lightly. Ready your cultivation and discern its arts before fighting again.

reason.zh-Hans: 撤离未成，群敌仍盘踞其间，宜整备后再入
reason.zh-Hant: 撤離未成，群敵仍盤踞其間，宜整備後再入
reason.en-US: Extraction failed; enemy forces still occupy the area. Regroup before re-entering.

reason.zh-Hans: 群敌合围，灵力溃散，归元之力正修复残躯
reason.zh-Hant: 群敵合圍，靈力潰散，歸元之力正修復殘軀
reason.en-US: Foes close in from all sides and Spirit Energy scatters—the power of Origin Return is mending your broken body.

reason.zh-Hans: 此次探索止步于此，待伤势平复后再寻撤离之机
reason.zh-Hant: 此次探索止步於此，待傷勢平復後再尋撤離之機
reason.en-US: This exploration ends here. Wait for your injuries to heal, then seek a chance to withdraw.

reason.zh-Hans: 强敌截断归途，此番撤离未成，宜审势后再入
reason.zh-Hant: 強敵截斷歸途，此番撤離未成，宜審勢後再入
reason.en-US: A powerful enemy has cut off the way home. This withdrawal failed; assess the situation before entering again.

reason.zh-Hans: 重压之下神魂震荡、灵力尽散，归元之力正重塑残躯
reason.zh-Hant: 重壓之下神魂震盪、靈力盡散，歸元之力正重塑殘軀
reason.en-US: Under immense pressure, the soul is shaken and spirit power dispersed; the power of Origin Restoration is reshaping the broken body.

reason.zh-Hans: 此次探索止于强敌，待洞悉其法、备妥丹符后再战
reason.zh-Hant: 此次探索止於強敵，待洞悉其法、備妥丹符後再戰
reason.en-US: This exploration ends before a formidable foe. Discern its arts and prepare pills and talismans before fighting again.

reason.zh-Hans: 此番遭逢凶险，经脉受创、灵力涣散，需静养调息
reason.zh-Hant: 此番遭逢兇險，經脈受創、靈力渙散，需靜養調息
reason.en-US: This dangerous encounter has damaged your meridians and scattered your spirit power. Rest quietly and regulate your breath.

reason.zh-Hans: 切磋胜负已分，此番技逊一筹，调息后可再请教
reason.zh-Hant: 切磋勝負已分，此番技遜一籌，調息後可再請教
reason.en-US: The spar is decided. Your skill fell short this time; after regulating your breath, you may study again.

reason.zh-Hans: 一时失手无损道途，复盘招式、稳固气息后再战
reason.zh-Hant: 一時失手無損道途，覆盤招式、穩固氣息後再戰
reason.en-US: A moment's misstep does not mar the Immortal Path. Review your arts, steady your breath, then fight again.

reason.zh-Hans: 承让此局，胜负皆为磨砺，来日再证所学
reason.zh-Hant: 承讓此局，勝負皆為磨礪，來日再證所學
reason.en-US: I accept this round. Victory or defeat is but tempering; we shall test what we have learned another day.

reason.zh-Hans: 此番交锋已成死斗，重伤之下物资散失，需先行休养
reason.zh-Hant: 此番交鋒已成死鬥，重傷之下物資散失，需先行休養
reason.en-US: This encounter became a fight to the death. Severely injured, your supplies have been scattered; rest and recuperate first.

reason.zh-Hans: 对手反击凌厉，神魂震荡、经脉受创，归元之力正修复
reason.zh-Hant: 對手反擊凌厲，神魂震盪、經脈受創，歸元之力正修復
reason.en-US: Your opponent's counter is fierce, shaking your Primordial Spirit and wounding your meridians—the power of Origin Return is mending them.

reason.zh-Hans: 强行出手反受其制，待伤势平复后再定进退
reason.zh-Hant: 強行出手反受其制，待傷勢平復後再定進退
reason.en-US: Forcing an attack only leaves you restrained in return; wait for your injuries to settle before deciding whether to advance or retreat.

reason.zh-Hans: 追兵杀意已决，此番未能脱身，所携物品随败退散失
reason.zh-Hant: 追兵殺意已決，此番未能脫身，所攜物品隨敗退散失
reason.en-US: The pursuers are bent on killing you. Should you fail to escape this time, the items you carry will be lost as you retreat in defeat.

reason.zh-Hans: 逃生途中身受重创，归元之力正重塑残躯
reason.zh-Hant: 逃生途中身受重創，歸元之力正重塑殘軀
reason.en-US: Gravely wounded while escaping, its ruined body is being remade by the power of Origin Restoration.

reason.zh-Hans: 来敌穷追不舍，待神魂归定、伤势平复后另寻生路
reason.zh-Hant: 來敵窮追不捨，待神魂歸定、傷勢平復後另尋生路
reason.en-US: The enemy pursues relentlessly. Once your Primordial Spirit is settled and your injuries recover, seek another way out.

reason.zh-Hans: 此轮胜负已定，整饬招式、调匀气息后再赴擂台
reason.zh-Hant: 此輪勝負已定，整飭招式、調勻氣息後再赴擂臺
reason.en-US: The outcome of this round is decided. Regroup your arts and regulate your breath before returning to the arena.

reason.zh-Hans: 擂台争锋重在证道，一局之失亦可照见不足
reason.zh-Hant: 擂臺爭鋒重在證道，一局之失亦可照見不足
reason.en-US: In arena contests, the point is to seek the Dao; even a lost bout can reveal one's shortcomings.

reason.zh-Hans: 此战虽负，道途未止，来日再以所学争胜
reason.zh-Hant: 此戰雖負，道途未止，來日再以所學爭勝
reason.en-US: Though this battle was lost, the Dao path continues. Another day, contend for victory with what you have learned.

reason.zh-Hans: 巨兽威势难当，此番挑战未成，待整备周全后再战
reason.zh-Hant: 巨獸威勢難當，此番挑戰未成，待整備周全後再戰
reason.en-US: The giant beast's might is overwhelming. This challenge has failed; regroup fully before fighting again.

reason.zh-Hans: 强敌一击震散护体灵力，调息稳气后可再试锋芒
reason.zh-Hant: 強敵一擊震散護體靈力，調息穩氣後可再試鋒芒
reason.en-US: A powerful enemy's strike has scattered your protective Spirit Energy. Regain your breath and stabilize your qi before testing your edge again.

reason.zh-Hans: 此等大敌非一人之力可轻撄，宜审势合力再战
reason.zh-Hant: 此等大敵非一人之力可輕攖，宜審勢合力再戰
reason.en-US: Such a formidable foe cannot be faced by one person alone. Assess the situation and join forces before challenging it again.
